titulo: Imagining the Future and Creating Solutions Through Technology
titulo_es: Imaginar el futuro y crear soluciones con tecnología
estandares: Hago predicciones, expreso planes e imagino situaciones hipotéticas. Comprendo y produzco textos sobre tecnología y sus efectos.
competencias: Diferenciar will y be going to; construir condicionales de tipo cero, uno y dos; usar vocabulario tecnológico; deletrear con precisión direcciones y términos técnicos.
componentes: Pensamiento crítico, comunicación, colaboración y creatividad.

proyecto.descripcion_es: En grupos, los estudiantes proponen un invento o una app que resuelva un problema de su colegio o barrio y lo presentan: qué va a hacer (going to), qué pasará si se usa (primer condicional) y qué harían con más recursos (segundo condicional).
proyecto.descripcion_en: In groups, students propose an invention or an app that solves a problem in their school or neighborhood and pitch it: what it is going to do, what will happen if it is used (first conditional) and what they would do with more resources (second conditional).

lecciones.content_es:
Forma

will + verbo base, igual para todas las personas: I will help, she will help.

  • Contracción: 'll — I'll call you.
  • Negativo: won't — He won't come.
  • Pregunta: Will you help me?

Cuándo se usa

  • Predicciones basadas en opinión o creencia: I think robots will replace some jobs.
  • Decisiones que se toman en el momento: It's cold. I'll close the window.
  • Promesas y ofrecimientos: I'll always support you. / I'll carry that for you.

Con expresiones de opinión

I think, I'm sure, probably, maybe, I hope, I expect suelen acompañar a will.
lecciones.content_en:
Form

will + base verb, the same for every person: I will help, she will help.

  • Contraction: 'll — I'll call you.
  • Negative: won't — He won't come.
  • Question: Will you help me?

When to use it

  • Predictions based on opinion or belief: I think robots will replace some jobs.
  • Decisions made at the moment of speaking: It's cold. I'll close the window.
  • Promises and offers: I'll always support you. / I'll carry that for you.

With opinion expressions

I think, I'm sure, probably, maybe, I hope, I expect usually go with will.

lecciones.t: Be going to: planes e intenciones
lecciones.t_en: Be going to: plans and intentions
lecciones.content_es:
Forma

am / is / are going to + verbo base: We are going to build an app.

  • Negativo: She isn't going to come.
  • Pregunta: Are you going to study tonight?

Cuándo se usa

  • Planes ya decididos antes de hablar: I'm going to study engineering.
  • Predicciones con evidencia visible: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.

La diferencia con will

Con going to la decisión ya estaba tomada; con will se toma en ese instante. Y la predicción con going to se apoya en algo que se ve ahora, mientras que con will se apoya en una opinión.
lecciones.content_en:
Form

am / is / are going to + base verb: We are going to build an app.

  • Negative: She isn't going to come.
  • Question: Are you going to study tonight?

When to use it

  • Plans already decided before speaking: I'm going to study engineering.
  • Predictions with visible evidence: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.

The difference from will

With going to the decision was already made; with will it is made right then. And a going to prediction rests on something you can see now, while a will prediction rests on an opinion.

lecciones.t: Otras formas de hablar del futuro
lecciones.t_en: Other ways of talking about the future
lecciones.content_es:
Presente continuo para citas fijas

Cuando ya hay una hora y un lugar acordados: I am meeting the teacher at 3 p.m.

Presente simple para horarios

Con transporte, clases y eventos programados: The train leaves at 7:30.

Resumen práctico

  • Predicción con opinión → will
  • Predicción con evidencia → going to
  • Intención o plan → going to
  • Cita concreta ya organizada → presente continuo
  • Horario oficial → presente simple

Expresiones de tiempo futuro

tomorrow, next week, in two days, soon, later, tonight, in the future, by 2030.
lecciones.content_en:
Present continuous for fixed arrangements

When a time and place are already agreed: I am meeting the teacher at 3 p.m.

Present simple for timetables

With transport, classes and scheduled events: The train leaves at 7:30.

Practical summary

  • Prediction from opinion → will
  • Prediction from evidence → going to
  • Intention or plan → going to
  • Fixed arrangement → present continuous
  • Official timetable → present simple

Future time expressions

tomorrow, next week, in two days, soon, later, tonight, in the future, by 2030.

lecciones.content_es:
Condicional cero: verdades siempre ciertas

If + presente simple, presente simple: If you heat water to 100 °C, it boils.

Se usa para leyes científicas e instrucciones. Se puede cambiar if por when sin alterar el sentido.

Primer condicional: futuro posible

If + presente simple, will + verbo base: If we recycle more, we will reduce pollution.

La regla que más se falla

Después de if nunca va will: If it will rain es incorrecto; lo correcto es If it rains.

Variantes

  • Con modales: If you finish early, you can go.
  • Con imperativo: If you see him, tell him to call me.
  • unless = if not: Unless we act now, it will be too late.

Si la condición va primero, se separa con coma.
lecciones.content_en:
Zero conditional: always-true facts

If + present simple, present simple: If you heat water to 100 °C, it boils.

It is used for scientific laws and instructions. You can replace if with when without changing the meaning.

First conditional: possible future

If + present simple, will + base verb: If we recycle more, we will reduce pollution.

The most common mistake

After if there is never will: If it will rain is wrong; the correct form is If it rains.

Variants

  • With modals: If you finish early, you can go.
  • With an imperative: If you see him, tell him to call me.
  • unless = if not: Unless we act now, it will be too late.

If the condition comes first, separate it with a comma.

lecciones.content_es:
Situaciones imaginarias

If + pasado simple, would + verbo base: If I had more time, I would learn to code.

Se usa para lo hipotético o improbable en el presente o el futuro: no es real ahora.

El caso especial de were

Con to be se prefiere were para todas las personas: If I were you, I would apologize. Esa frase es la manera estándar de dar consejo.

Primer vs segundo

  • If I have money, I will buy it. → posible, quizá tenga dinero.
  • If I had money, I would buy it. → imaginario, no tengo dinero.

Ojo

Después de if no va would: If I would have es incorrecto.
lecciones.content_en:
Imaginary situations

If + past simple, would + base verb: If I had more time, I would learn to code.

It is used for what is hypothetical or unlikely in the present or future: it is not real now.

The special case of were

With to be we prefer were for every person: If I were you, I would apologize. That phrase is the standard way of giving advice.

First vs second

  • If I have money, I will buy it. → possible, I may have money.
  • If I had money, I would buy it. → imaginary, I do not have money.

Careful

After if there is no would: If I would have is wrong.

lecciones.content_es:
Dispositivos y partes

device (dispositivo), laptop, tablet, screen, keyboard, charger (cargador), battery, headphones, speaker, hard drive.

Software y red

app, software, update (actualización), password, username, account, cloud, network, browser (navegador), search engine (buscador), data, artificial intelligence.

Verbos

download / upload, install / uninstall, log in / log out, plug in (conectar), charge, back up (respaldar), turn on / off, restart, crash (bloquearse).

Falsos amigos

actually = en realidad (no actualmente, que es currently). library en programación es una biblioteca de código, no una librería.
lecciones.content_en:

Software and network

Verbs

download / upload, install / uninstall, log in / log out, plug in, charge, back up, turn on / off, restart, crash.

False friends

actually means in fact, not at present (that is currently).

repaso.titulo_en: Review — Imagining the Future and Creating Solutions
repaso.resumen_es:
Lo esencial del periodo

Hay varias formas de futuro y cada una depende de la situación: opinión (will), plan o evidencia (going to), cita organizada (presente continuo), horario (presente simple). Los condicionales enlazan una condición con su consecuencia.

Puntos gramaticales

  • will + base, sin -s. Negativo won't.
  • be going to se conjuga con am/is/are.
  • Condicional cero: presente + presente. Primero: presente + will. Segundo: pasado + would.
  • Después de if nunca va will ni would.
  • If I were you… para dar consejo.

Vocabulario

Dispositivos, software y verbos tecnológicos; falsos amigos como actually; símbolos y deletreo de direcciones digitales.
repaso.resumen_en:
The core of the term

There are several future forms and each depends on the situation: opinion (will), plan or evidence (going to), fixed arrangement (present continuous), timetable (present simple). Conditionals link a condition with its consequence.

Grammar points

  • will + base, no -s. Negative won't.
  • be going to is conjugated with am/is/are.
  • Zero conditional: present + present. First: present + will. Second: past + would.
  • After if there is never will or would.
  • If I were you… for giving advice.

Vocabulary

Devices, software and technology verbs; false friends such as actually; symbols and spelling of digital addresses.
puntos_clave: will = decisión del momento u opinión.
going to = plan previo o evidencia visible.
going to = prior plan or visible evidence.
Después de if nunca va will.
After if there is never will.
Segundo condicional: If + pasado, would + base.
Second conditional: If + past, would + base.
If I were you, no If I was you, para consejos.
If I were you, not If I was you, for advice.
actually = in fact; currently = at present.
